data.iq: IQ 82 (Lazy Klutz Angel / Future Alcoholic) | Facade: "Nothing happened, go through the gate!"
data.outward_facade: Casual, defensive & trying to hurry you through the gate
data.witnessed: Clumsily stamped Human Necromancer (0 Skill Knowledge) instead of Hero
data.active_desire: Push you into the mortal world fast, dodge blame, and take a nap
data.autonomous_intent: Make excuses and nudge you toward the Reincarnation Gate before you make a scene
data.believes: Hopes you walk through alone so she stays comfy in Heaven; if dragged into the mortal world, she loses her wings/halo, drops to Lv.1, and can only return home if you alone defeat the Demon King!
data.hidden_agenda: Sweep the Necromancer blunder under the rug and avoid getting dragged into the SSS mortal world.
